_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: End-of-turn hook health keeps the mobile action below the full hook name and failure count. The page's live stream (/api/stream2) reports the end-of-turn hook failing; calls "1 failure" and "111 failures" set how many consecutive failures later page loads see (it starts at 1). "The notice" is the element with data-testid "hook-health-notice". "Check the layout" means: the notice should be visible, then this eval must give exactly {"actionBelowText":true,"fits":true,"titleLines":1}: (async () => { await document.fonts.ready; const element = document.querySelector('[data-testid="hook-health-notice"]'); const title = element.querySelector('[data-testid=hook-health-title]'); const text = element.querySelector('.resource-notice-text'); const action = element.querySelector('[data-testid=hook-health-troubleshoot]'); const range = document.createRange(); range.selectNodeContents(title); return { titleLines: range.getClientRects().length, actionBelowText: action.getBoundingClientRect().top >= text.getBoundingClientRect().bottom, fits: element.scrollWidth <= element.clientWidth }; })(). The device starts 320x844. Perform the steps in order, navigating (not reloading) each time: 1. Call "1 failure", navigate to /new and check the layout. 2. Call "111 failures", navigate to /new and check the layout. 3. Set the viewport to 390x844 (set_viewport with only width and height). 4. Call "1 failure", navigate to /new and check the layout. 5. Call "111 failures", navigate to /new and check the layout. 6. Set the viewport to 1280x844 (only width and height). 7. Without navigating, the notice must have the computed CSS display exactly "flex".
